parameters.content:
## Project 4 v3 - PREMIUM

**Matches Sample Report Quality:**
✅ Header with meta badges
✅ Key Metrics cards (28%, $127, etc.)
✅ Data Foundation (P2/P3 bullets)
✅ Content Ideas with data tags
✅ 3 Campaign concepts
✅ 6 Email subjects with icons
✅ Competitive Angles section
✅ Content Priorities (1,2,3,4)
✅ TikTok captions added

Enhancement: Added four ready-to-film short-form video scripts (Art Across Homes, Kids vs. The Rug, The Next-Gen Designer, and Rug of the Month), plus scene-by-scene rendering in the HTML report and Wayfair voice guidance.

Enhancement v4: Added five optional input fields (target audience, seasonal context, content focus, specific product, and competitor focus). These are passed into the AI prompt and displayed in the report's Content Brief & Personalization section. Blank fields have sensible fallbacks.
